This waiver and release of liability (“Waiver”) are made for {{FirstName}} {{LastName}} (“Volunteer”) in favor of Common-Unite, a Missouri non-profit corporation (“Organization”).


Purpose of Volunteer Services: Volunteer is participating in activities as a volunteer for the Organization and acknowledges that the Volunteer Services may include, but are not limited to, the following tasks: manual labor and office support.


Release of Liability: Volunteer acknowledges that the Volunteer Services may involve certain risks, including but not limited to physical or emotional injury, property damage, or death, and Volunteer assumes all such risks. Volunteer agrees to hold harmless, release, indemnify, and defend the Organization, its officers, directors, employees, agents, and representatives (collectively, the “Released Parties”) from and against any and all claims, demands, damages, costs, expenses, and liability of any kind arising out of or in connection with Volunteer’s participation in the Volunteer Services, including but not limited to any injury or damage to Volunteer or Volunteer’s property.


Medical Treatment: Volunteer hereby grants permission to the Organization to authorize and obtain any medical treatment deemed necessary for Volunteer in the event of an emergency arising during Volunteer’s participation in the Volunteer Services. Volunteer acknowledges that the Organization is not responsible for the payment of any medical treatment or related expenses.


Photographic Release: Volunteer grants to the Organization the right to use and publish photographs of Volunteer, or in which Volunteer may be included, for editorial, trade, advertising, and any other purpose and in any manner and medium; to alter the same without restriction; and to copyright the same. Volunteer hereby releases the Organization and its legal representatives and assigns from all claims and liability relating to said photographs.


Governing Law: This Waiver shall be governed by the laws of the state of Missouri.


Entire Agreement: This Waiver constitutes the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior negotiations, understandings, and agreements, whether written or oral.


Amendments: This Waiver may not be amended except in writing, signed by both Volunteer and the Organization.
